fields.name: Utah Workforce Services · Job Search and Training Help
fields.description: Free job-search help and a way to apply for career or training assistance. Ask DWS which local office to visit.

informationSections.programsAndServices: Help with resumes, applications, interviews and finding work. Career and education assistance has a separate application and eligibility review.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: General job-search help is available to job seekers. Training support depends on your circumstances and the program; a counselor decides eligibility.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Use the website for job-search tools. For career and education assistance, apply online or at an Employment Center. Call the general DWS service number, 801-526-0950, to confirm a local starting point.
informationSections.access: Utah, including Salt Lake City. Online career applications need a UtahID account; in-person applications are also offered.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: For career assistance, a counselor should contact you within three business days to arrange an appointment. Submit required documents within 45 days. Applying does not guarantee training funding.
